description: The file defines a React-like component named 'RecipeForm' using Qwik framework. It provides a form interface for creating or editing recipes, including fields such as title, cuisine, type, description, ingredients, and instructions. The component manages internal state, validation, and handles form submission.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs form validation checking required fields such as title, ingredients, and instructions.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, validates the form, constructs the input object, calls the onSubmit$ prop, and manages submission state.
